purpose: Close schema-only card-ID and weak clause-semantics promotion paths.
requirements: Unconditionally reject known broad/page shells (post-content, entry-content, main/content/catalog/layout shells) regardless of class markers or ID attributes. A nested actual card may qualify independently.

Replace schema-only stable ID acceptance with authenticity proof: ID must be present in sealed capture metadata/manifest mapping for the selected source, or have a documented cryptographically bound equivalent. Record the mapping key and digest.

Require directed locality semantics: an offer-binding predicate must govern the claimed locality target; reject a clause that binds an offer to another city, contains conflicting localities, or merely co-locates a target city with a generic promotion phrase.

Require validity semantics: the validity/recurrent predicate and target year must be in a clause that asserts offer applicability/effectiveness. A branding, planning, copyright or unrelated sentence containing 2026 is insufficient.
Add a mandatory regression using div.post-content deal-card data-offer-id=deal-abc, a Da Nang travel mention, a Hanoi promotion clause, and a branding-2026 recurrence clause. It must be HELD.

Add positive controls for a metadata-authenticated card ID and directed Da Nang locality/2026 validity, plus negative controls for pattern-valid but unauthenticated ID, conflicting city locality, and generic 2026 co-occurrence.

Keep verify-existing default and non-mutating; --generate must be explicit. Evaluate only sealed R3 bytes, preserve 0 VERIFIED / 10 HELD unless all checks pass, and perform no hydrate/package/deploy/scheduler/alias/rollback mutation.
acceptance_gate: CEO verify-existing replay and code review required; no automatic promotion
